text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you want to boost your health luck, 
here, and here too...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that'll do it! With the purifying 
salt in place, everyone can train safely 
now☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa, the salt mound collapsed! Where 
did that wind come from!?

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!? Why is the hallway all 
gritty!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'll clean it up right away~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tossed about by the wind and the salt 
piles, Copano Rickey was left completely 
exhausted...
